content: None asahan ta Jises
Ano Malawin Ndrabun andrei Jises iu ili kon lomale an ta balik kanone iy.
Hamon ta Jises abeles iy ta nyamon udu bolo hanoh (40) len hanoh (40) ben eme ma iy imeson.
Ya balik eme asahan hawen, ma iy tiye i buku doh, “I buku none ou anya ou Nadu Kindrei, ou asehek sahou kili toro bek dah kasahan jabi ramen.”
Eme ya Jises tiye i buku doh,

content.text: “Ndratorowenei, ‘Lau winiyan balelei le jabi ramen ta samak bwe, arile na sahou mari eme len asahan boho Kindrei.’” Dutoronomi 8:3

content: Ano balik andrei iy, uru au ala Jerusalem kon ndrabun, eme ma balik atehei iy ales udu bwele-e no-o asiu tinan ta Kindrei loken on.
Ano balik tiye i tan i buku doh, “Ou anya ou Nadu Kindrei handru eh, ou akahei ou ado dah ala andri. Tasah i buku ndratorowenei,

content.text: ‘Kindrei kameh edeu sahou batanau ili tiri angelo tan ame ta aseben ou. Ma idah kameh, iri bwese-ei ou, ma bek winiyan batahi katim bwe.’” Wari 91:11-12

content: Jises tiye i buku doh i tan, “Ndratorowenei ale,

content.text: ‘Ou satehei Laban Kindrei tam sala ta bolo none.’” Dutoronomi 6:16

content: Ano ja balik andrei iy uru au ala bwele-e mandrei ari lawe-en, eme ma balik leheya iy ta boto-on ma lomadan tiri kon tinan mari badu munyak, iri kabin atondrok.
Eme ma balik tiye i ta Jises i buku doh, “Jo winiyan atehei lakou mari dah ewek tam, i buku ou atehei bwili ndru-um i andri keme tek, ma atudun nyarak.”
Jises tiye i tan i buku doh, “Ou a len, Satan, tasah ndratorowenei ale,

content.text: ‘Ou atudun le nyara Laban Kindrei tam, ma ou a-en hamon tan le ari kabwe.’” Dutoronomi 6:13

content: Ano ya balik ruwani iy udu, ma iy iu, eme iri angelo ta Kindrei ame bwese-ei Jises ma aseben iy.
Jises leheya ma asehek sahou tan ma bwena
Na len Jises anuhun iri ndratehei Jon ta alomwa ndrala bolo kou, iy iu ili Galili ja.
Ano iy ruwani Nasaret ma iy iu ili manyah udu Kapena-um. Ya kon doh udu mirihik ta gwa li ari udu bolo munyak ta Sebulun ma udu bolo munyak ta Naptali.
Iri lakou doh asahan ta amekes sahou dah abadok ma i handru i le buku propet Aisaya ndrasihidiy:

content.text: “Munyak ta Sebulun ma munyak ta Naptali,
san amwenen ili ndras amwenen le ta Jodan.
Ya Galili badeh, munyak tiri lau badu leheleh,
ya iri lau badeh ado bolo lulik
arile iri ndratou lomadan tinan ndrasahan;
udu bwele-e oro lau ale ado bolo munyak udu koroha imek
eme ya lomadan ndrasahan tiri.” Aisaya 9:1-2

content: Udu bada len doh Jises asehek sahou ma bwena handru, eme ma iy tiye i buku doh: “Ado katobolowe ndrine ado, ma ado katikisiy handru ta kandriyen ndra-in tado, tasah tondrok ta Kindrei ndrame mirihik.”
Aloh ta oro lau tan ma bwena
Jises edek kabede gwa li Galili ma iy atou Saimon, iri aloh iy ale Pita, uru nadu tinen Enduru. Uru akeh kubwin ili bolo gwa li ta akohok ni, tasah uru lau ta bwisir ta ni.
Eme Jises tiye i turu i buku doh, “Ah kame ka-en hamon tek. Ya idah kameh jo leheya ah san ta akohok lau.”
Eme ya nawin bwe uru ruwani kubwin turu, ma uru au a-en hamon tan.
Iy edek ili bwena ja, ma iy atou Jemis nadu Sebedi hawe nadu tinen Jon. Uru ado bolo ndron hawe tama uru Sebedi, lowosa kubwin toro. Jises eme aloh uru,
eme ya, nawin bwe uru ruwani ndron ma hawe tama uru udu gwek, ma uru au a-en hamon ta Jises.
Jises amekes iri lau sik udu tiri amwenen
Jises edek ili loboho Galili mara-ei, leheya ma asehek sahou mwasin ta tondrok ta Kindrei udu bolo asiu ta atukum tiri Juwis, ma iy bwidi iri sik ndra-in mari udu bada iri lau iu.
Nyaran ma sihide lahou iy amekes aseker i bolo Siriya mara-ei,

eme ya iri lau atiye iri lau sik udu tiri, ma iri lau sik tiri bwidi iri sisi-in labai, ya hawe iri lau balik lolowa iri ma bwidi iri lolo-ou, ma hawe iri lau kati iri ma mine iri winiyan ta bales bwe. Iri tiyani iri lau mari doh ame hawen, eme ma iy bwidi iri lau mari doh amwenen ja.
Eme ma iri lau solo-an badu Galili, ma iri lau badu Dekapolis,
ma iri lau badu Jerusalem, ma iri lau badu Judiya, ma hawe iri lau badu kon udu loboho Jodan bilisiu ya iri lau mari doh adek a-en hamon tan.

footnotes.text: Iri lau badu leheleh doh badeh, ndraye iri Juwis bwe. Iri tana iri Laban bwe. Boho iri jam aloh haiden o genta-el
Na len Rom atondrok kon, munyak tiri Isra-el hawe iri kon solo-an ja iri aloh, Siriya.
Dekapolis, moson badeh, kon tinan ma ronoh.
